name: hcportal_getKennelWebsite
description: Returns the kennel's HC.KennelWebsite configuration row for the portal's Edit Website form. If the kennel has no row yet, inserts a default one (Enabled 0, ThemeMode 'dark', ScrollBlur 0) first, so the form always has a row to load. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId as the context identifier (the token is bound to the kennel id, but that is not a permission check). No kennel permission gate: any authenticated portal caller can read any kennel's website config, and can cause the default row to be created.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Portal device ID — passed to ValidatePortalAuth

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived device token for this SP name

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Public GUID of the kennel to load website config for — also used as the auth scope in ValidatePortalAuth

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned alone on auth failure, 'Null or invalid publicKennelId', 'Kennel not found', or from the CATCH (ERROR_MESSAGE(), not logged to HC.ErrorLog).

rowsets.name: KennelWebsiteConfig
rowsets.description: On success: exactly one row (a default row is created first if none existed). Columns in SELECT order.

columns.name: customDomain
columns.description: Custom domain e.g. lh3.com; NULL = subdomain only

columns.name: urlShortcode
columns.description: HC5 legacy WebsiteUrlShortcode — review vs KennelUniqueShortName

columns.name: enabled
columns.description: KennelWebsite.Enabled — a BIT column, so the API serialises it as a JSON boolean (true/false), not 0/1

columns.name: accentColor
columns.description: CSS hex colour for accent; falls back to primaryColor if NULL

columns.name: scrollBlur
columns.description: 0–100; controls backdrop-filter blur intensity on hero scroll

columns.name: ogImageUrl
columns.description: Open Graph share image URL (1200×630px recommended)

columns.name: buttonPrimaryColor
columns.description: Primary action button background (#RRGGBBAA); defaults to primaryColor

columns.name: runCardColor
columns.description: Run card surface colour; defaults to cardBackgroundColor

columns.name: titleText
columns.description: Custom display name shown in hero (may differ from KennelName)

columns.name: mismanagementJson
columns.description: JSON array of committee contact entries

columns.name: extraMenusJson
columns.description: JSON array of custom nav menu items

columns.name: controlFlags
columns.description: Bit flags for feature toggles (HC5 WebsiteControlFlags)

columns.name: pageFeaturesJson
columns.description: JSON object controlling which nav pages are enabled. Column added by db/hc6/public-web/archive/add_pagefeaturesjson.sql (NVARCHAR(4000)); not in the base table file.

sideEffects: Inserts a default HC.KennelWebsite row (Enabled=0, ThemeMode='dark', ScrollBlur=0) if none exists for the kennel

codeSmells.detail: Lines 59-63: IF NOT EXISTS ... INSERT on the KennelId key with no lock hint and no transaction. Two first-time loads at once can both pass the check; the second INSERT fails with a duplicate key and the user gets the CATCH envelope.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 107-110 return {Success 0, ErrorMessage} with no HC.ErrorLog row.

After auth (line 32) nothing checks the caller's rights for this kennel; any portal user can read the config (all of it is shown publicly on the site anyway) and trigger the default-row insert for any kennel.
db/schema/tables/HC.KennelWebsite.Table.sql declares Enabled BIT; the house rule is SMALLINT, and clients must parse it as `== true || == 1`.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from the rowset — Flutter reads all columns by name
Never rename a column — camelCase aliases are the API contract
Never change the default values inserted on auto-create without reviewing all callers
